sources.title: AI4Bharat Models
sources.snippet: Indic Speech-to-Text Conformer IndicConformer is a conformer based ASR model containing only 30M parameters, to support real-time ASR systems for Indian languages. The model is trained on ULCA, KathBath, Shrutilipi and MUCS datasets. The model can be deployed on an android device and can be accessed via websockets.
